#Cabinet has created a pathway for all #Agniveers to be absorbed into the Indian Defence Forces. 
As you know, 25% of Agniveers will enrolled in the Forces, based on merit. Previously, the Scheme envisaged that 75% of Agniveers would transition back into civilian life as disciplined and motivated youth. However, the remaining 75% will now be given an extended engagement period of two years under the scheme. 📢Haryana🛣️

In Haryana, we have approved ₹340.78 crore for the construction of a 2.75 km-long, 6️⃣-lane elevated corridor at the intersection of NH-919 and NH-248A at Sohna Chowk in Nuh district.

The continuous elevated corridor will segregate Gurugram–Nuh through traffic from local and cross traffic, ensuring signal-free and uninterrupted movement through Sohna. It will also strengthen connectivity with the Delhi–Mumbai Expressway (DME) and KMP Expressway.

Considering rising traffic demand, rapid urbanisation and future growth, the project will significantly ease congestion, enhance road capacity and improve regional connectivity along NH-248A.
